title: dev.acp.tokenized.card handler config, as Siontology's merchant declares it
description: The config of ACP's card handler (version 2026-01-22) on a Siontology merchant: the merchant's id at its PSP, which a delegated card's allowance must name, and what it takes.

merchant_id.description: The merchant's id at its PSP: a delegated card's allowance.merchant_id.

accepted_brands.description: The card brands taken (visa, mastercard, amex, discover, ...).

psp.description: Who charges the token: stripe, or the name of an ACP PSP that redeems its vault tokens.
